summary: Tested Scavvy end-to-end (Expo web + FastAPI). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (health, adventure/start, mission/analyze incl. attempt>=2 always success, mission/easier, adventure/summary). Frontend happy path completed on 390x844 viewport: splash -> onboarding (welcome, look, signup 'Nishant', personality explorer + THAT'S ME, style SURPRISE ME, camera Not now, location Maybe later) -> Home (shows 'Hey, Nishant', 4 day streak / 27 missions / Explorer Lv 3) -> START ADVENTURE -> 3 mission cycles (Mission Reveal shows MISSION 01/02/03 + title + FIND IT; camera gate offers 'Continue with a sample find'; Analyzing cycles then routes to Success/Failure). Also observed: FAILURE path triggered on M1 attempt 1 ('Hmm... nice try.' with TRY AGAIN + MAKE IT EASIER); TRY AGAIN succeeded on attempt 2. Success screen shows 'THAT COUNTS!', +XP, NEXT MISSION advances; last mission button correctly reads 'SEE MY RESULTS'. Adventure Complete screen shows 3/3 missions, 320 XP, +1 streak, AI summary line, and 4 trait bars (Explorer/Observation/Curiosity/Chaos). GO AGAIN returns to Home. Adventures & Profile tabs load; Profile shows 'Nishant' + Reset Scavvy button. Mascot images render on splash, welcome, home, reveal, camera-gate, analyzing, success, and complete screens - no missing-asset boxes seen. Fixed one small testing blocker: T (Text) component was not forwarding testID to the DOM; added testID prop so mission-title/analyzing-status/success-headline/complete-headline are queryable.

react_native_issues.issue: useNativeDriver warning on web: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Non-blocking on web preview; expected on native. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (Animated.spring/timing with useNativeDriver: true) and other screens.

Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Coming from theme shadow.* usages. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.soft/card/button) used across ui.tsx, success.tsx, analyzing.tsx, camera.tsx.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' Reference: /app/frontend/app/mission/camera.tsx:128 <View style={styles.companion} pointerEvents="none">.

action_items: Optional polish (not blocking): migrate shadow.* to boxShadow in theme.ts to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
Optional polish: move pointerEvents="none" to style.pointerEvents in /app/frontend/app/mission/camera.tsx:128.
Optional polish: consider removing useNativeDriver on web-only Animated calls to silence warning (or gate by Platform.OS).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses logger before it is defined (logger.warning inside start_adventure runs before logging.basicConfig/logger assignment at bottom of the file). Currently harmless because the try/except catches AttributeError only silently on error paths, but move the logger initialisation above the routes for correctness.
server.py MongoDB insert stores mission dicts but never reads them back; if adventures are ever fetched, remember to exclude the '_id' field to keep responses JSON serialisable.
T component previously dropped testID; fixed. Consider also forwarding accessibilityLabel for a11y.
expo-router web keeps prior screens mounted, so testIDs match multiple elements — this is documented and handled with .last in tests; add unique route-scoped testIDs if you want simpler selectors.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx (T now accepts and forwards testID prop)
/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (new pytest suite for all Scavvy endpoints)
seed_data_creation: None. All requests are stateless / mocked. Test adventures inserted into Mongo use 'TEST_' name prefix (adventures collection) and are non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. For frontend, use 390x844 mobile viewport. IMPORTANT: expo-router web keeps prior screens mounted, so testIDs (find-it-button, web-demo-find-button, next-mission-button, try-again-button, start-adventure-button) can match multiple elements — always use page.locator('...').last and .wait_for(state='visible'). Onboarding flow order: lets-find-it-button -> show-me-button -> name-input+create-account-button -> (personality-explorer)+thats-me-button -> surprise-me-button -> camera-not-now-button -> location-maybe-later-button. Mission attempt>=2 is guaranteed success in backend.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no functional bugs found. The only fix applied was the T component missing testID forwarding, which was a test-instrumentation gap, not a user-visible bug.
